title: Check: networking and storage consolidation
description: Five questions spanning the whole phase.

questions.prompt: Put these in the order a request traverses them from outside: Ingress, Service, Pod, ingress controller.
questions.explanation: The Ingress object is configuration read by the controller; the controller forwards to the Service, which selects the Pod.

questions.prompt: You need traffic from outside on a raw TCP port, with no HTTP routing. Which?

options.text: A Service of type NodePort or LoadBalancer

questions.explanation: Ingress is HTTP(S)-oriented. Raw TCP belongs to a Service type, or to the Gateway API's TCPRoute.

questions.prompt: A workload needs storage that survives rescheduling to another node. Which?

options.text: A PVC backed by a networked or cloud volume

questions.explanation: emptyDir dies with the Pod and hostPath is tied to one node. Only a real PV follows the workload.

questions.prompt: A Service has no endpoints. Which could explain it? Choose all that apply.

options.text: No Pod carries the matching labels
The Pods exist but are not Ready
The Service's targetPort does not match the container port
The cluster has no default StorageClass

questions.explanation: The first two empty the EndpointSlice; the third fills it but sends traffic to a closed port. Storage is unrelated.

questions.prompt: Any connectivity problem inside the cluster deserves which check early?

options.text: Whether the name resolves at all

questions.explanation: Half of what looks like a network fault is DNS. Resolve first, then connect.
